name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-02-12, at wavelengths from 0.87 to 4.91 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
